title: Average total order value across customers
prompt: Using the orders15 table, first compute the total order amount for each customer, then return the average of those per-customer totals as a single column named avg_customer_total.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE orders15 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer TEXT, amount INTEGER); INSERT INTO orders15 VALUES (1,'Alice',100),(2,'Alice',200),(3,'Bob',50),(4,'Bob',50),(5,'Bob',100),(6,'Carol',300);
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(customer_total) AS avg_customer_total FROM (SELECT customer, SUM(amount) AS customer_total FROM orders15 GROUP BY customer) t;
